title: ICE agents pepper spray pregnant US citizen in California, video shows
summary_full: Lizbeth Vargas Andrade, 23, was taken down by officers and arrested on her stomach during a protest, her attorney saysUS Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) agents pepper-sprayed a pregnant US citizen and threw her to the ground during a protest in California on Sunday, according to her family’s attorney, who shared footage of the incident.Lizbeth Vargas Andrade, 23, was filming and protesting the presence of several ICE officers outside the Stanislaus county jail in Modesto, in California’s central valley, before she was taken down by officers and arrested on her stomach during a chaotic encounter.
